format_prefix_literal: Output-format contract only. Return JSON satisfying the supplied schema. Optional fields remain optional; this adds no research requirements. Preserve supported substantive findings and choices in schema-compatible fields. Inspect each invalid_value at its instance_pointer. For invalid source citations, consult the supplied ID-to-record mapping; correct a reference only when that record supports the original claim, otherwise state that claim's lack of support in permitted fields. Never guess a replacement ID or invent a source. For verbatim_quote errors, copy an exact supporting excerpt from the supplied role response; if no supporting excerpt exists, correct the assessment using the supplied rubric. Do not add research advice. Do not emit another role's decision fields outside the permitted properties.
